rows.grounds: compound gūḍha + sadbhāva, accusative singular masculine
verb pra-jan, present middle third singular

items.question: How does knowing the hidden true nature of that produce all-knowingness?
premises: knowing hidden true nature yields all-knowingness
taṃ denotes the hidden true nature
items.inference: Realization of the concealed true nature gives rise to omniscience.
uncertainties: the exact referent of taṃ depends on prior context
items.plain_english: Having known that hidden true nature, all-knowingness arises.
